title: Biography: Kenny Rogers
overview: Chronicles Roger's life from his childhood, through the rise and fall of The First Edition, the iconic release of "The Gambler," and to the height of his career as a successful solo artist, actor and pop-culture icon. Utilizing live performances and behind-the-scenes moments from Rogers' 2017 star-studded farewell concert in Nashville, this "Biography" special pays tribute to a true country music legend.
